tuple_v0.doc: Maps (registrant, scheme_id) to their stealth meta-address (64 bytes:\nspending_pubkey || viewing_pubkey).
tuple_v0.name: MetaAddress

function_v0.doc:
Register or update a stealth meta-address.

# Arguments
* `registrant` - The address whose meta-address is being set (must authorise).
* `scheme_id`  - The stealth address scheme identifier.
* `stealth_meta_address` - 64-byte value: `spending_pubkey || viewing_pubkey`.
function_v0.name: register_keys

udt_error_enum_v0.doc: Errors that the registry can produce.
udt_error_enum_v0.name: RegistryError

cases.doc: The supplied stealth meta-address is not exactly 64 bytes.
cases.name: InvalidMetaAddressLength

cases.doc: No stealth meta-address has been registered for the given address and scheme.
cases.name: NotRegistered

function_v0.doc:
Look up a previously registered stealth meta-address.

# Arguments
* `registrant` - The address to look up.
* `scheme_id`  - The stealth address scheme identifier.
function_v0.name: stealth_meta_address_of
